_note: The shape of your work, and the single taxonomy every tracked item points at. Every record in a ledger, every todo line, and every tracker item names exactly one node id from this file. Structure is yours: Domain > Client or Product > Initiative > Item > Thread is one shape that works, but depth is not fixed. Node ids are PERMANENT: renaming one orphans everything filed under it, so change `label` instead and leave `id` alone. Retire a node with "status": "archived" rather than deleting it. Maintain with .agent/scripts/work_tree.py; `refs` and `sources` are filled by whatever links your tickets and documents in.
period: REPLACE ME - the reporting window this snapshot describes
